title: feat(platform-objects)!: Setup's organization, team, business-unit and user records carry no Discussion feed (enable.feeds: false)
body:
Fixes #23838

Clause-②: no (narrowing: the comment create door refuses on four platform objects that accept it today)

## What changes

`sys_organization`, `sys_team`, `sys_business_unit` and `sys_user` (`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/`) declared no `enable.feeds`, so they took the spec default (`true`) and the console drew "Discussion (0)" with a comment composer on every identity record in Setup (objectui#12614 item 1). Each `enable:` block now declares `feeds: false`, with a two-line comment naming the reason. No other line in those files moves.

Both consumers of the flag already exist, so nothing else changes:

- the console reads `objectDef?.enable?.feeds !== false` (objectui `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx:1754` at objectui `63d00da`) and strips the Discussion nodes when it is false;
- plugin-audit's `enforceFeedsCapability` (`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-writers.ts`, `beforeInsert` and `beforeUpdate` on `sys_comment`) refuses a comment whose `thread_id` names an object with `enable.feeds: false`, with the existing `403 FEEDS_DISABLED`. No new error code.

The changeset (`.changeset/23838-identity-feeds-off.md`) is a `minor` breaking entry under the launch-window convention, with the same Clause-② line and an ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` disposition: no spec key, export or stored shape moves, and stored comment rows are kept.

## Measured through the public door

CRM app booted `--fresh` on a random port from this branch (platform-objects and plugin-audit closure rebuilt at `4e5399c4b`), signed in as the seeded admin:

| request | answer |
| --- | --- |
| `POST /api/v1/data/sys_comment` with `thread_id` `sys_user:USER_ID` | `403` `{"code":"FEEDS_DISABLED","object":"sys_user"}` |
| the same with `sys_organization:ORG_ID` | `403` `{"code":"FEEDS_DISABLED","object":"sys_organization"}` |
| CONTROL: the same with `crm_account:ACCOUNT_ID` | `201`, row created |
| `GET /api/v1/meta/object/NAME`, the four identity objects | `enable.feeds` = `false` on all four (what the console reads) |
| `GET /api/v1/meta/object/crm_account` | `enable.feeds` absent (the console reads absent as on) |

The server was stopped after the probe (its PID only); its tempdir is gone.

## Producer search (dispatch assumption 2): no platform code writes a comment into these threads

Searched at the branch base `66d456d01`:

- every quoted `sys_comment` in non-test code: the only writers are plugin-audit's own hooks (the feeds gate, `comment-access-hooks.ts`, the mention hook, which writes notifications, not comments) and the CLI's comment-reactions migration (`packages/cli/src/utils/comment-reactions-conversion.ts`), which inserts `sys_comment_reaction` rows only;
- every quoted or templated thread literal naming one of the four objects (`'sys_user:`, `'sys_organization:`, `'sys_team:`, `'sys_business_unit:`): hits only in the `sys_comment.thread_id` description example and its four translation bundles, one `parseCommentThreadId` unit test and one driver-test code comment, none a writer;
- every `thread_id` assignment and every `OBJECT:ID` template near comment code in non-test sources: reads and keys only (the access hooks' visibility filter, a mention dedup key, a cache key);
- `examples/**` and every seed or fixture path: no `sys_comment` rows; the dogfood comment fixtures use their own four `cmt_*` objects;
- objectui at `63d00da`: the record page creates `sys_comment` only from the Discussion composer, which is behind the same `feedsEnabled` read.

Not searched: the `cloud` repository, which is not in this container.

## Pins

One file, `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/identity-objects-feeds-off.test.ts`. It boots a real `ObjectQL` over a stub driver with the REAL four definitions imported from `@objectstack/platform-objects/identity` (aliased to source in this package's `vitest.config.ts`, so the verdict is about the checkout, not `dist/`) and the real `installAuditWriters` hooks:

- per object (`it.each`): a new comment on one of its records rejects with `code: 'FEEDS_DISABLED'`, `status: 403` and the object named, and no row lands;
- grandfathered row on `sys_user`: the gate is first shown live on that exact thread, then a row written below every hook (what a row stored before this change is) stays readable through `find`, and a body edit without `thread_id` still saves;
- CONTROL: a business object that never mentions `enable.feeds` still accepts a comment.

The pins live in plugin-audit because `@objectstack/platform-objects` has no runtime dependency on `objectql` or `plugin-audit` (plugin-audit depends on platform-objects; the reverse would be a cycle), so the real gate cannot be exercised there. This file is `domain:services` territory, as the claim anticipated. The generic gate stays pinned where it was: `audit-writers.test.ts` (insert) and `capability-gate-update-verb.test.ts` (update verb and the grandfathered edit).

## Ablation (one-time proof, not kept)

Each leg ran after the fix was committed, through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode (literal anchor, on-disk counts, blob hash before and after, restore proven by blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`), running `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/identity-objects-feeds-off.test.ts`. No build or `dist/` leg is owed: the identity definitions resolve to `src/` through the alias, and the gate mutation is in the package under test.

| mutation | anchor | blob before, after | result |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| delete `feeds: false,` in `sys-user.object.ts` | 1 to 0 | `df41d5b3c3f3`, `84847d0be0b7` | 2 failed / 4 passed: the `sys_user` case and the grandfathered-row case |
| delete it in `sys-organization.object.ts` | 1 to 0 | `cfcbe12495aa`, `33e67fccd9dd` | 1 failed / 5 passed: the `sys_organization` case |
| delete it in `sys-team.object.ts` | 1 to 0 | `3a0954909643`, `df521d289587` | 1 failed / 5 passed: the `sys_team` case |
| delete it in `sys-business-unit.object.ts` | 1 to 0 | `0db7f124c9d4`, `e5f6d7a3d360` | 1 failed / 5 passed: the `sys_business_unit` case |
| invert the gate in `audit-writers.ts` (`feeds === false` read as `feeds !== true`) | 1 to 0 | `f556c52ac945`, `4a3379a3fc5f` | 1 failed / 5 passed: the CONTROL |

Every leg restored to its HEAD blob, and the tree was clean after the run.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit test`: 52 files, 839 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit typecheck`: exit 0; the new file is in plugin-audit's `tsconfig.test.json` program (`--listFiles`).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 65 commands, each run with its exit code captured before any pipe, all exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 65 accounted for, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- The four artifact-roster gates whose roster sits under a directory this diff touches: `check-changeset-fixed`, `check:authz-resolver`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:filter-alias-parity`, all exit 0.
- Not run locally, CI's: the declared wide-population families, the five path-scheduled jobs (Test Core, Build Core, the dogfood pair, Temporal Conformance) and the workspace type-check lanes.

## Acceptance notes

- This PR also changes the `sys_comment.thread_id` example from `sys_user:abc123` to `account:9001`: the description and docblock in `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/objects/sys-comment.object.ts`, the `en` bundle regenerated by `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`, and the zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES leaves swapped by hand. After this change, a comment created by following the old example answers `403 FEEDS_DISABLED`. (Written by the `domain:engine` seat 2 from the dev's patch-round report; the claim's file-surface amendment is 6213345119 on #23838.)
- Comments already stored on these records are kept and stay readable through the data API; the record page no longer shows them, because the console strips the Discussion section when the flag is false. The changeset says so.
- Being a narrowing, this owes one review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` before the queue.
